name: entra
discoveryUrlWhy: The v1.0 document advertises iss: https://sts.windows.net/{tenant}/, which does not match the iss in the v2.0 tokens Entra issues. Token validation then fails with insufficient_scope.
audienceNote: the resource app GUID, not api://<GUID> -- Entra sets aud to the application id
identifierUriHint: Register the gateway URL as an identifier URI on the resource app.
MCP clients send it as the RFC 8707 `resource` parameter, and Entra
rejects the /authorize call with AADSTS9010010 until it is
registered. The consent portal does NOT need this.
OBJECT_ID=$(az ad app show --id "{audience}" --query id -o tsv)
portalCallbackHint: --web-redirect-uris REPLACES the whole array. Under Entra this app is
also the gateway resource app and may already carry other web redirects
(e.g. a credential provider's vended callback); pass every URI you need
in one call so you do not drop them.
resourceAppDeleteHint: the {displayName} resource app -- it is the gateway's audience
AND the portal's login client, so it is not this script's to delete.
cleanup_gateway_entra.py leaves it too; delete it yourself once the
gateway is gone (az ad app delete --id <{audienceEnv}>).
